meta.description: Dog grooming across Hall Green and the WF4 villages near Newmillerdam, Wakefield — Crigglestone, Sandal, Horbury, Haigh, Notton and into the Barnsley side.

hero.heading: Local to Hall Green, serving the wider Wakefield area.
hero.body: Most of our customers live within a 5-minute drive of the salon in Hall Green — but we groom dogs from right across the Wakefield WF4 villages and into north Barnsley. Pick your area below for local details, drive times and the questions we get asked most.
hero.photoAlt: A young golden retriever in the woods near Newmillerdam

overview: We're based on Castle Meadows in Hall Green — the WF4 village just south of Newmillerdam Country Park — and most of the dogs we groom come from within a five-minute drive: Crigglestone, Chapelthorpe, Newmillerdam, Sandal and the surrounding WF4 and WF2 streets. We also groom plenty of dogs from a little further out, from Horbury and Calder Grove across to West Bretton, Notton, Woolley and into Haigh on the Barnsley side.

Wherever you are, the offer is the same: a calm, one-dog-at-a-time groom in a quiet home salon, published prices confirmed before any work starts, and easy parking right outside — no city-centre traffic and no hunting for a space. Pick your area above for local drive times, landmarks and the questions we get asked most.

contactCta.heading: Not sure if we cover your area?
contactCta.body: Give Keith a quick call or message — if you're near Hall Green or anywhere across the WF4 villages and into north Barnsley, there's a good chance we can help.
